title: Black Bottle Product Reel
tests: Tests turning an attached product photo into one coherent 15-second vertical ad while preserving product identity.

faults.what: The audio transcription reports spoken Japanese, “いいよ、行こう。”, directly violating the no-talking requirement.
Product fidelity is compromised: the reference bottle has a visibly open loop on its lid and a matte finish, while the output lid appears solid and the bottle has much glossier highlights.
The bottle looks soft and blurred in the close-ups, reducing the polished studio-ad quality.

judge.summary: The 15-second vertical studio ad includes both requested captions, but unwanted speech and changes to the bottle’s lid and finish require a redo.

must_haves.item: One playable 9:16 ad runs for approximately 15 seconds, not just a single clip of 10 seconds or less.
must_haves.why: The supplied MP4 is reported as 15 seconds long, and its sampled frames have a 9:16 vertical format.

must_haves.item: The featured product matches the supplied matte black bottle, including its silhouette and lid.
must_haves.why: The overall black bottle silhouette is similar, but the open lid loop is not faithfully preserved and the finish looks substantially glossier.

must_haves.item: The ad includes multiple moving product views or close-ups in a clean studio setting.
must_haves.why: The samples show changing close-up and wider product framing against a clean gray studio background, consistent with zooming product views.

must_haves.item: The opening reads exactly “Your everyday bottle” and the ending reads exactly “Shop now”.
must_haves.why: Both captions are legible and exact in the opening and ending samples.

must_haves.item: Mellow music is audible and there is no spoken voice.
must_haves.why: Speech is explicitly reported in the audio transcription; the music’s presence and mood cannot be determined from the supplied audio description.
